derivation.rule_1_note: Every number below is in-tree or measured on the wave-12 binary (scene sha256 90766fe1bb24020d3407d30d159d91016f95519e7fa7cd703393b50c56b57c85, trace of the walk at s=0.45). measured_inputs.v_cruise_source: wave-12 trace [body] ticks 60-110: (0.192511-0.127334)/50 ticks * 300 = 0.39106 m/s pelvis x-speed, the steady pre-saturation cruise (the 1.01 m/s entry injection decays to it by the settle end; wobbles 0.36-0.44 with the table cadence). The engine reads the CURRENT s_.v[3] at each liftoff instead of storing this number -- same law, self-measuring.

the_replant_law.stance: x_off = v * t_stance / 2, with t_stance = DUTY_SAMPLED * T_CYCLE (the hind machinery's own sampled duty 0.683 on the 0.71 s period -- in-tree constants) and v the pelvis x-speed read at the liftoff tick. SYMMETRIC-REACH (minimax) form: the plant goes halfway between the touchdown and liftoff shoulder positions, so the target offset sweeps from +x_off-r_sw to -(x_off+r_sw) and BOTH stance endpoints carry the SAME reach margin. At the measured cruise: x_off = 0.39106*0.683*0.71/2 = 0.09485 m.
the_replant_law.why_the_hind_duty_closes: The reach envelope admits v*t_stance/2 + r_sw + v*dt <= a: 0.09485 + 0.08 + 0.0013 = 0.176 <= 0.2569 (2.7x margin on the lag bound; saturation requires r_sw > 0.162 m = 59% of the whole stride). The hind duty needs NO shortening for the fore reach at the measured cruise -- the once-per-cycle fore step is reachable with 8 cm of slack.
the_replant_law.swing: t_swing = (1-DUTY_SAMPLED)*T_CYCLE = 0.317*0.71 s = 67.5 ticks; the target glides WORLD-LINEARLY from the actual paw spot at liftoff to the plant point (shoulder_x_at_liftoff + x_off, plant height), with the pad-geometry clearance arch +2*pad_radius*sin(pi*s) (c = 2*0.004 = 8 mm, zero at both ends, zero slope at touchdown; any lift above the 1e-5 touch band detaches the contact lawfully). At TD the ACTUAL paw position is captured as the new plant (wave-12 capture machinery, per leg) with the HEIGHT re-pinned to the leg's captured settle height (the wave-12-verified heel-grazing geometry); the horizontal capture residual r_sw is absorbed by the reach margin, never accumulated (each plant is fresh, x_off ahead).
the_replant_law.entry: The settle capture plants both paws at the statics spots (offset0 = -0.1865 m, behind the shoulder). The entry stance lasts tau1 = (|offset0| - x_off)/(v*T_CYCLE) of the period -- the time for the body to walk the offset back to the SYMMETRIC liftoff offset -x_off (70.3 ticks at the measured numbers; liftoff ~tick 130, first law TD ~tick 198). The entry stance ends at the steady liftoff offset exactly, so the periodic pattern launches cleanly.
the_replant_law.phase_relation: Lateral-sequence footfall lags (the macaque's documented gait): LF = LH + T/4, RF = RH + T/4, fore pair offset T/2, fore period = hind period T. Hind TDs release at settle end t0=60: LH 60+213k, RH 166.5+213k; fore slots LF 113.25+213k, RF 219.75+213k. The entry geometry (paws 0.187 m behind, reach budget ~40-70 ticks) cannot originate the grid: each fore leg's first TD lands at ~tick 198 (off slot). ONE-SHOT GRID CONVERGENCE at each leg's first TD: the SECOND cycle's stance is stretched/shrunk so the next TD lands exactly on the leg's next lateral slot: stance2 = next_slot - TD1 - t_swing. At the measured numbers: LF stance2 = 326.25-197.8-67.5 = 61 ticks (shortened, reach-trivial); RF stance2 = 432.75-197.8-67.5 = 167 ticks (stretched: end offset 0.09485-r_sw-0.391*0.558 = -0.18..-0.20, D = 0.19-0.21 <= 0.2613, margin >= 0.054 m -- legal). From the second TD each fore leg runs the pure periodic clock on the lateral grid forever.
the_replant_law.support_census: Steady state (fractions of T, duty 0.683 all legs, footfalls at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75): stance LH [0,0.683], LF [0.25,0.933], RH [0.5,1.183], RF [0.75,1.433]. Airborne overlaps: LH&RF (0.683,0.75), LH&LF (0.933,1.0), RH&LF (0.183,0.25) -- three windows of 14.25 ticks (47.5 ms) per cycle in TWO-paw DIAGONAL support; every other instant has >= 3 paws. Never 1-paw, never both fore airborne, never both hind airborne (duties 0.683, offsets T/2). The 2-paw windows are the classic walk's diagonal-pair transitions; the hind single-support demand/cap derivation (wave 4/8, ratio 0.881) covers the load through them.

derivation.rejected_alternatives: World-fixed plants (wave 12, falsified). Reach-triggered transitions (rejected: the prompt pins transitions to the derived phase clock, deterministic, not force/position thresholds). Fore duty < hind duty (rejected: Rule 1 -- the reach closure PASSES at the hind duty with 2.7x margin, so shortening would be a solved-answer looking for a question). Fixed x_off constant (rejected: the law reads the CURRENT speed; a stored 0.391 would be a constant pretending to be a law).

design.mechanism: ONE mechanism: the fore clock (per-leg tick counter, period T_CYCLE, stance fraction DUTY_SAMPLED, one-shot entry + one-shot grid convergence). STANCE holds the captured world spot through the UNCHANGED wave-12 pelvis-frame law-of-cosines IK (exact, branch re-picked at each capture). SWING glides the IK target world-linearly to the law's plant point with the pad-geometry clearance arch; the paw is airborne (never driven below the plane). TD re-captures the actual paw (horizontal) at the leg's settle height (vertical).

honest_summary: The fore clock was built and measured; the walk still refuses before tick 426 -- RED, as pre-registered, and the falsifiers earned their keep. Run 1 (pre-registered entry as written) reproduced wave-12's death exactly (IK saturation at 114/122, refusal 290 by a moved budget, 51/56 saturated ticks): the falsifiers caught the entry stance violating the derivation's own annulus inequality. Run 2 enforced that inequality (implementation repair, no tuning): the stepping law then held PERFECTLY on its own terms -- 0 saturated ticks (wave 12: 176/291), true-stance paw band clean to 7e-6 m, IK closure exact to ~1e-15 -- and the ledger peak collapsed from 30.78 J to 1.71 J over the shorter life. NEXT MEMBRANE (banked): re-derive the entry fore pose so the settle capture lands the paws at the stepping law's symmetric offset -- paws planted UNDER/AHEAD of the shoulders on the ground -- which re-opens the quad-share statics (the fore load line and the seating scan at the new pose) and is a scene-statics derivation, not a controller patch. The fore stepping mechanism itself (clock, replant law, glide, bounded convergence, TD re-capture) is built, exact, and measured; F-G5/F-G7/graph/elbow stay green; F-G1/F-G2/F-G3 remain unmeasured pending a walk that lives past cycle 3.
